title: Replacement Terms and Proof of Delivery: Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
**Replacements in general.** A replacement on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program ships at no charge, draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer. It is recorded against the original shipment it replaces, and its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

**Proof of delivery.** A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier, with a signature where the tier or item requires a signature on delivery, and it fixes the delivery date that the return, damage and warranty windows count from; a package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.

**The cases**

| Case | When it is replaced | How |
|---|---|---|
| Lost in transit | no proof of delivery is on file for the package and the tier's carrier trace period, in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays), has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date | always replaced, expedited at no charge, and never counted toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery |
| Damaged in transit | the customer reports the damage no later than the tier's damage report window, in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package, counted from that delivery date with the last day allowed | replaced; a later damage report is not replaced |
| Delivered but not received | the proof of delivery shows the package as delivered and the customer reports it not received | replaced as a courtesy only while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the tier's courtesy reship limit; beyond that the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill |
| Defective as shipped | expired or short-dated strips, strips that do not match the meter on the program, a broken vial seal, or a manufacturer-recalled lot, reported no later than the tier's defect report window, in calendar days after the delivery date | replaced by Larkfield as a product defect; Larkfield replaces as a product defect only such an item |
| Meter failure under warranty | a meter that fails within the meter warranty, in calendar months of its delivery date | replaced by its manufacturer under warranty through the manufacturer's customer line |

**Counting courtesy reships.** The courtesy reships counted are the program's replacement shipments with the reason delivered but not received whose ship date falls in the 365 calendar days ending on and including the reship date being considered. The limit is a record fact, read from the program's shipment history.

**Damage window, both sides (hypothetical).** With a 7-day window and a proof-of-delivery date of the 3rd, a damage report made on the 10th is replaced and one made on the 11th is not.

**Courtesy limit, both sides (hypothetical).** With a limit of 1, a program with no courtesy reship in the 365 days ending on the reship date may receive one; a program that already had one in that span may not.
